name: QuickBooks Online MCP Server
description: Query and update QuickBooks Online invoices, customers, bills and financial reports from AI assistants with Intuit's local MCP server, for accountants and developers.

skills.name: Manage Entities
skills.description: Searches QuickBooks Online customers, invoices, bills, vendors and items, and creates, updates or deletes those records.

skills.name: Financial Reports
skills.description: Generates QuickBooks Online balance sheet, profit and loss, cash flow, trial balance and general ledger reports.

skills.name: Receivables and Payables
skills.description: Pulls aged receivables and aged payables reports from QuickBooks Online to show which customers owe and which bills are due.

skills.name: Invoice PDF
skills.description: Downloads a QuickBooks Online invoice as a PDF, returned inline as base64 or saved to a configured folder.
